Container.Name: bluos-doorbell
Container.Overview:
Plays a doorbell chime on Bluesound BluOS players and restores the exact prior volume and source afterwards, including when players are grouped.
Triggered by a UniFi Protect Alarm Manager webhook.
Reads every player's own volume rather than the grouped /Status copy, sends one chime per group primary, and gates concurrent rings so a double press cannot save the already-ducked volume as the restore target.
Requires host networking: the players must be able to reach this service to fetch the chime file.
Edit config.yaml in the config folder, then restart the container.
Updates: push to main, CI publishes to GHCR, then Check for Updates and Apply Update here. Config and chimes live in appdata, so an update never touches them. Confirm what is running at http://[IP]:8095/health — it reports the git sha of the build.

Config.Name: Config directory
Config.Description: Folder holding config.yaml. Seed it from config.example.yaml in the repo.

Config.Name: Chimes directory
Config.Description: Folder holding the chime audio. The players fetch these over HTTP from this service.

Config.Name: Config file path
Config.Description: Path to config.yaml inside the container. Leave as-is.

Config.Name: Chime directory path
Config.Description: Path to the chimes folder inside the container. Leave as-is.
